Download First Touch Soccer 2026 Mod APK Obb Data file which works fully offline, full transfers of players to there various club has been done, kits updated and more.

First Touch Soccer 2026 Mod, you can create your own football club, play league matches with improved graphics, better ball control and take your club to the top of the league in the current season.

FTS 2026 Mod APK football clubs, now have kits update, as you will see every players in there new season kits and it makes the game look so unique on your Android device.

Control buttons are visible, in such a way you can easily control your team during a match game play, without any lagging issues, dribble, shoot and score a goal.

Commentary sound is very clear when playing FTS 26 Mod for Android, as you can hear the commentators reacting to the performance of every players around the football pitch.

There’s unlimited amount of money for you to use and manage your own football club, buy players during transfers window or market from another club. Also use it to upgrade your stadium.

When playing FTS 2026 live match, you will hear the crowd cheering, this makes the game look so realistic for you to enjoy.

How To Install First Touch Soccer 2026 (FTS 26) Mod Apk Data Obb Files

To install FTS 2026 Mod Apk Obb Data files, kindly follow the steps below which are in two sections, first section we are starting with how to extract the data file using Zarchiver App.

Section 1: How To Extract FTS 2026 Rar or Zip Data File

  1. Using installed Zarchiver App, locate and click on Data FTS 2026 Zip or Rar file, from options menu that comes up, click “Extract”.
  2. Immediately navigate to the top of Zarchiver App interface, and click 0/storage/emulated.
  3. From the drop down menu click “Device Storage”.
  4. Followed by clicking “Android folder”.
  5. Then click “Data folder” and wait to check step 6.
  6. Finally click “Extract button” which looks like a arrow pointing downwards.

Section 2: How To Extract FTS 2026 Obb Rar Or Zip File 

  1. Open installed Zarchiver App again, locate Obb FTS 2026 Rar or Zip File, click on it, from the options menu click “Extract”.
  2. Immediately Navigate to the top of Zarchiver App interface and click 0/storage/emulated.
  3. From the drop down menu that appears, click “Device Storage” and proceed to next step.
  4. Now click Android folder.
  5. Then Click Obb folder.
  6. Stay in the Obb folder and click “Extract Button” which looks like a arrow pointing downwards.
  7. Finally Install FTS 2026 Mod Apk.
